app.title: SongRush
app.credit: Data sources: AnimeThemes, AniList, anime-offline-database, AniDB, Wikidata

start.noOpus: This browser cannot play the audio. Please update your browser or iOS to the latest version.

lobby.waiting: Waiting for the host to start the game...
lobby.abandoned: The game was stopped, so you are back in the lobby.
lobby.whoHost: Only the host can change these
lobby.whoPending: The host is choosing the settings
lobby.shareHint: Send the link: a friend only enters a nickname to join
lobby.copyFailed: Could not copy. Press and hold the address to copy it

filter.reversed: The start year is later than the end year.

answer.label: Answer format
answer.hintChat: Guess the anime title in the chat
answer.hintChoice: Pick from {{k}} covers (4, 6 or 8 by difficulty)

mode.label: Game mode
mode.hintFirst: Only the first to get it right scores
mode.hintRanked: The song goes on until everyone answers or picks, and points follow the ranking

stage.label: Stage
stage.watching: You are watching this song. You play from the next one.
stage.loadFailed: This song could not be played.
stage.hint: Type the anime title in the chat to guess the song
stage.sub: Korean, English, Japanese and romaji titles all count. Spaces and punctuation are ignored.
stage.soon: When the song plays, type the anime title in the chat
stage.soonSub: Everyone hears the same song at the same moment.
stage.choiceSoon: When the song plays, pick its anime from the covers
stage.choiceHint: Pick the anime of the song you hear from the covers
stage.choiceSub: You can pick only once. If you miss, watch the rest of this song. Nobody else sees your pick, and the chat is just for talking.
stage.pickWrong: No. {{n}} is wrong. Wait for the answer.

reveal.heading: Answer
reveal.next: The next song starts in a moment
reveal.nextFinal: The final ranking is up in a moment

chat.label: Chat
chat.lobbyJoined: You joined room {{code}}. The host is choosing the settings

game.replaced: You connected from another window, so this one was closed.

error.bad-nickname: Enter a nickname of 1 to 16 characters.
error.not-enough-songs: There are not enough songs to play.
error.too-long: Chat messages can be up to 200 characters.
error.room-full: The room is full (8 players max).
error.in-game: A game is in progress. Please join after it ends.
error.not-host: Only the host can start the game.
error.server-full: The server is full. Please try again shortly.
error.rejoin-failed: Could not reconnect. Please join the room again.
error.already-in-room: You are already in a room.
error.no-room: You are not in a room.

feedback.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before sending again.
